metadataReview.note: Retain 17 August 1645, independently confirmed by the Brazilian Army. Add an approximate locator for the Casa Forte square / former engenho sector. The Recife municipal account explicitly places the modern square on the former engenho where the battle occurred; the heritage diagnosis relates the old campina to the church and former casa-grande. This is a sector reference, not the excavated footprint of Anna Paes’s house or a precise assault position. The municipal coordinate document is expressly preliminary and referential.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: Recife’s published preliminary inventory of tourist signs/points gives Praça de Casa Forte (PM-07 / PTM-134) latitude -8.03581, longitude -34.92010 on PDF page 7; the latitude/longitude columns and referential disclaimer are on page 1. Round to longitude -34.9201, latitude -8.0358. The municipal 2012 account explicitly ties this square to the former battle-site engenho, corroborated spatially by the heritage diagnosis page 9. The point locates that broad historic sector only. It does not claim the current garden plan or its 1934 commemorative monument existed in 1645, and no exact house footprint or numerical accuracy radius is inferred.

note:
The Recife municipal account explicitly identifies the Casa Forte engagement as a fight between Portuguese and Dutch forces; the Brazilian Army confirms the date and opposition to Dutch rule. Two event-local formations are used in distinct camps. These broad historical labels do not assert uniform nationality, ethnicity, branch composition, equipment or central-government control over every combatant. The formerly published Kingdom of Portugal Q45670 and Dutch West India Company Q617066 entries are replaced by these local formations; their exact original item and P710 statement citations are retained with the corresponding force as provenance. Their participant IDs are not claimed to be preserved. Both former groups had no quantified observations. Strength, deaths and casualties remain unknown; no number, casualty ratio, equipment profile or equipment identity is inferred.
